description: Returns required ANX-RFC-001 (ZK_PROV_V1) manifest fields for a collateral class and validates an optional candidate manifest object, listing missing keys and attestation readiness. Use when: checking required manifest keys or pre-validating a candidate JSON payload before SHA-256 hashing. Do not use when: validating an existing 64-hex SHA-256 digest (use verify_asset_hash instead), signing a provenance certificate (use generate_zk_provenance_proof instead), or auditing portfolio LTV caps (use verify_underwriting_compliance instead). Behavior: Read-only, stateless, deterministic schema check (p99=28ms; free discovery tier at 60 RPM without billing).

collateral_class.description: Specialty collateral category whose ANX-RFC-001 manifest schema is inspected (default: "fine_art").

manifest_payload.description: Optional candidate collateral manifest JSON object validated for required ANX-RFC-001 keys (asset_id, collateral_class, optical_scan_sha256, custody_event_hashes, appraised_value_cents). Omit to list required fields only.

name: inspect_manifest_schema

missing_fields.description: Required manifest keys absent from manifest_payload.

payload_checked.description: True when a candidate manifest_payload object was supplied.

ready_for_zk_attestation.description: True when manifest_payload was supplied and missing_fields is empty.

title: Collateral Manifest Schema & Field Validator
